title: Psionic Ward Armour
summary: Medium Armour that heals on successful spell saves and gives Githyanki Psychic resistance.

fields.Armour Class: 15 + Dexterity modifier, with up to +2 from Dexterity. Medium Armour proficiency. Disadvantage on Stealth checks.
fields.Psionic Ward: Regain 1d4 HP each time you succeed on a save against a spell. Githyanki wearers also gain Psychic resistance.
fields.Acquisition: Worn by Ch’r’ai Tska’an near the bridge to the To Baldur’s Gate waypoint in Reithwin, X −249, Y −33.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
